heading: Join the Hack Club Slack
body: Hop into the Hack Club Slack and say hi in the channel. This is where you'll hang out, ask questions, and get support from others working on the project.
detail: Make sure you've joined the #embassy channel so you don't miss announcements, deadlines, or fun updates from the people organising it.

heading: Build something identity-related
body: Spend 7 hours building a project related to identity to earn the Passport or ID, or 14 hours for both. It can be anything you can dream up.
detail: Some ideas: a passport-style generator, a face detection tool, a username finder, a digital signature app, or anything else that feels like it's about who you are.

heading: Ship it
body: Finish your project, make sure it actually works, and submit it. Give it your best, ship something you're proud of, and you're golden!
detail: Double Dip is not allowed (yet), but you're always welcome to submit a brand new project. Keep it polished and make sure it's something you'd be proud to show off.

heading: Get your ID in the mail
body: Once your project is reviewed, your very own Hack Club ID will be shipped to your doorstep. A nice little memory of Hack Club that doesn't hurt to keep :D
detail: Reviews can take a little while. The organiser is often working alone and juggling exams, so please be patient! Reach out on Slack if you have any concerns.
